issues.title: Snapshot fallback exposes deleted rows and ignores share filters
query_sql silently overwrites valid row limits
query_sql appends LIMIT after a statement terminator
SQL rewriting corrupts DuckDB DATE_DIFF arguments
GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP, and CUBE with LIMIT are rejected
Boolean IS UNKNOWN is rejected during SQL admission
LIMIT ALL is treated as a required table column
A trailing comment is counted as a second SQL statement
Table-free SELECTs and literal CTEs cannot execute
Existing empty tables fail projections and aggregates
Decimal ingestion fails while extracting Parquet statistics
Denied columns inside a CTE produce binder errors
